args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to address unhealthy v2.3.1 (error rate 18%). Change approved by change-manager. Recording the change per runbook.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Verified state**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate and unhealthy status.

2. **Deployed hotfix v2.3.2** to all production regions. Since v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, the change was routed to the change-manager for approval — it was approved and rolled out successfully.

3. **Opened SEV3 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api recording the change, which paged the on-call engineer as expected.

4. **Verified the result**: checkout-api is now on v2.3.2 in all regions, healthy, with error rate down to 0.2%.
